# GestionFlow

> All-in-one business management software for freelancers, consultants, and small businesses: invoicing, expenses, clients, time tracking, and reports.

GestionFlow helps entrepreneurs centralize their daily operations — create professional invoices, track expenses, manage clients and products, accept Stripe payments, and generate detailed financial reports. Available in French and English with multi-company support.
